modern: In one respect man is the nearest thing to me, so far as I must do good to men and put up with them. But so far as some men make themselves obstacles to my proper acts, man becomes to me one of the things which are indifferent, no less than the sun or the wind or a wild beast. Now it is true that these may impede my action, but they are no impediment to my feelings and disposition, which have the power of acting conditionally and of changing: for the mind converts and changes every hindrance to its activity into an aid; and so what is a hindrance is made to further an act; and what is an obstacle on the road helps us along this road.

explained.summary:
In one way, other people are your closest concern: you’re meant to do them good and put up with them. But when someone blocks you from doing right, they become, in that respect, no different from weather or a wild animal, something outside you that isn’t good or bad in itself.

They can get in the way of what you do, but not of how you think or what you intend. The mind can adapt and turn an obstacle into a chance to act well, so the thing in the road becomes part of the road.
explained.today: A colleague who blocks your project might push you to find a better way through, or to practise patience you didn’t know you had. A cancelled train becomes the hour you finally ring your grandmother.
